segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Para español, oprima el dos.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics, part of Pretty Good AI.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: How may I help you today?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Am I speaking with Dayan?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Actually, it's Dayon. Dayon Geller. Yes, that's me calling. I'm looking to get an appointment

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: scheduled. It's September 14, 2026. Yes, that's correct. September 14, 2026.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Thanks, please provide your date of birth.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Just to confirm, is your date of birth September 14th, 2026?

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: What kind of appointment would you like to schedule today?

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: For example, is this for a routine checkup, a follow-up, a new patient consultation,

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: or something else?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: I'm looking for a general appointment.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: A routine checkup would work well for me.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: What dates and times do you have available?

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Do you have a preferred provider or would you like to see the first available?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: I'm flexible.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: The first available works fine for me.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Whatever slots you have open, I can work with that.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: There are no open appointments between today and next Monday.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Would you like to look for times later next week or try a different date range?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Later next week works for me. What do you have available then?

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: I'm not seeing any open appointments through the first week of October either.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Would you like me to keep searching further out or would you prefer to have someone from the office follow up with you directly?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: You can go ahead and keep searching further out.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: I'm willing to work with whatever availability you find.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: What does the schedule look like beyond that?

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: I'm still not seeing any open appointments, even into early November.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: Would you like me to have someone from the office follow up with you directly to

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: find a time?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Yes, that would be helpful.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Please have someone from the office follow up with me directly to work out a time that

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: works.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Before we finish though, I also need a refill.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: The controlled medication was sent to me last time and I need it refilled.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: I've documented your request for a medication refill and your need to

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: schedule a routine checkup. The office will follow up with you as soon as

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: possible the help of both. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: No, that covers everything.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Thanks for your help.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: I appreciate you documenting both the appointment and the medication refill request.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: I look forward to hearing from the office.

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: You're all set. Die in. The office will reach out soon about your appointment and

segments.speaker: PGAI Clinic Agent
segments.text: medication refill. Have a great day!

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Thanks, I appreciate it.

segments.speaker: Patient / Dayan Geller
segments.text: Have a good day.
